text:
alex: heads up — edgecase-inc is seeing two hours of missing usage in the console (hours 2026-03-15T08:00Z and 09:00Z show zeros). customer reports alerts fired. can we triage?

infra-bot: alert: tenant-hours-missing for tenant=edgecase-inc (2h). consumer_lag=25k on topic=ingest-hours, partition=12

lina: thanks @alex — looking. when did backfill run last for that tenant?

alex: we kicked a targeted backfill yesterday at ~22:30 UTC (manual requeue job). job finished according to scheduler but customer says metrics still missing for that window.

sam: quick checks: consumer group offset for ingest-hours shows partition 12 stuck (CURRENT=120034, HEAD=142000). might be Kafka controller churn earlier today. run: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group ingest-hours`

julie: @sam can you paste the exact offsets and lag? customer is jittery.

sam: partition 12: lag=21966, partition 7: lag=0, partition 3: lag=12. it looks like only partition 12 is behind (affects tenant shard for edgecase-inc).

lina: if the backfill wrote completed manifests to s3 but consumer never processed partition 12, we might have a manifest->manifest-list mismatch. checking s3 manifest prefix for edgecase-inc/backfills/2026-03-14/ ...

infra-bot: s3 event: PUT s3://ingest-manifests/edgecase-inc/backfills/2026-03-14/manifest-0007.json (size 18KB)

alex: customer mentioned they retried the backfill once from the console. were both attempts deduped?

lina: plausible dedupe bug recorded in changelog for the requeue path. Requeue creates new manifest id but if manifest-list contains only the original, consumer filters out new id due to `already_processed` flag. looking at manifests now.

sam: I can force consumer to reprocess that partition with `consumer-reset --group ingest-hours --partition 12 --offset 120000` but prefer to investigate root cause first.

julie: customer wants ETA. we should give an ops ETA and do a safe remediation. recommend small remediation: run reconsume for partition 12 in read-only mode so no duplicates written to downstream.

lina: found anomaly: manifest-0007 references file `hourly-rollup/2026-03-15/08/edgecase-inc.parquet` but the manifest-list contains a stale pointer to `edgecase-inc.tmp.parquet` for same hour. consumer skips tmp objects. that explains zeros.

sam: ok — remediation plan: 1) patch manifest-list to point at final parquet (manual small write) 2) restart consumer on partition 12 -> will process and emit hourly row. 3) run a validation query: `select count(*) from console.hours where tenant_id='edgecase-inc' and hour='2026-03-15T08:00Z'`

alex: please coordinate with oncall. julie, can you approve manual manifest update? we need audit trail.

julie: approved — do it during low-traffic. notify customer that we're doing a safe corrective write and will verify.

infra-bot: deploy plan: patch manifests (manual S3 put) -> restart consumer on partition 12 -> monitor metrics (expected resolution within 30-45m).

sam: performing manifest edit now (will keep original as manifest-0007.bak). command: `aws s3 cp s3://ingest-manifests/edgecase-inc/backfills/2026-03-14/manifest-0007.json - | jq '.files[0].path = "hourly-rollup/2026-03-15/08/edgecase-inc.parquet"' | aws s3 cp - s3://ingest-manifests/edgecase-inc/backfills/2026-03-14/manifest-0007.json`

lina: after patch, I'll tail consumer logs: `kubectl logs -f deploy/ingest-consumer -c consumer | grep edgecase-inc`

infra-bot: consumer restart triggered by sam at 1839997798.

sam: restart done. partition 12 offset progressed: CURRENT=120034 -> 123500 in 90s.

julie: customer updated: seeing hour 08 backfilled on their console UI after ~7 minutes. they still missing 09:00Z — looks like next file also had tmp pointer.

lina: scanning next manifest-0008 — same tmp object. I'll patch manifest-0008 and restart again if needed.

alex: great work team. action items: lina to patch manifest-0008, sam to monitor consumer drift, julie to update customer with timeline and postmortem ETA. I'll open a follow-up ticket to address dedupe/requeue logic so requeues don't write tmp pointers to manifest-list.

julie: updated customer: "we've applied corrective writes and restarted processing; hour 08 is visible, we're working on hour 09 and will follow up with a full postmortem by EOD." :thumbsup:

sam: consumer now caught up for partition 12, lag=0. verifying downstream rows.

lina: patched manifest-0008 and validated parquet availability. downstream shows both hours present. adding note to incident timeline about manifests and requeue dedupe.

alex: closing thread once postmortem ticket created. thanks everyone.
